hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/cook-forest-state-park/stay ('Full-hookup campsites also have: On-site water, 50 amp electric, Sewage hookup'; 'Electric-only sites are available with either 30 or 50 amp hook ups') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880202 (22 Full-Hookup sites list water and sewer; 50 public sites list 50-amp, 40 list 30-amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR says 210 campsites in Ridge Campground; the booking site lists 204 (114 Modern-Rustic Non-Electric, 68 Modern-Rustic Electric, 22 Full-Hookup) in the Front and Back Sections. Listed max vehicle lengths are short at many sites: about 30 ft is the commonest figure, 82 sites list 15-20 ft, and about 46 take 40 ft (one 50 ft, site 129). A few are pull-through (080, 122, 124, 179, 180). Pets on designated sites for a fee.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cook-forest-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880202 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + the DCNR stay page ('The park has 210 campsites'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Modern restrooms with showers all season, weather permitting; shower houses 3 and 4 close in freezing temperatures. Coin-operated laundry.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/cook-forest-state-park/stay ('Modern restrooms with showers are available for the duration of the camping season', 'There is a sanitary dump station and coin-operated laundry facilities'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/cook-forest-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880202 (Booking Window for Full-Hookup, Modern-Rustic Electric, Modern-Rustic Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window; season already manual (mid-April to mid-October). Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 22 full-hookup sites, 210 campsites (204 on RA) up to 50 ft with a few pull-throughs, showers/dump/laundry. Many sites list only 15-20 ft but ~119 take 23 ft or more. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
